messages:
Ana: Sunset rooftop scrimmage tomorrow 6pm? weather looks perfect — 68°F, light breeze. jerseys optional. 
Devon: I'm in. Can bring a spare ball and the little orange cones. 
Liam: in if I can duck out of the 6:30 sync. count me tentative. 
Tara: I'll bring a Bluetooth speaker + portable charger. also - halftime snack poll: tacos 🌮, bagels 🥯, or empanadas 🫓?
Chris: tacos for the win. 
Ana: vote below or reply with your choice. planning to grab from the food truck outside the lobby.
OpsBot: Poll started: "Halftime snack" — options: tacos, bagels, empanadas. React with :one:, :two:, or :three:. Poll closes in 12 hours.
Devon: :one: tacos. also heads-up: rooftop gate closes at 7:30pm.
FacilitiesBot: Reminder — rooftop access requires badge after 5pm. If anyone needs guest access, reply with their name by 3pm.
Liam: can someone add me as guest for 6pm? i'll be with non-employee friend. 
Tara: @Ana can you RSVP Liam as guest? I can vouch. 
Ana: added Liam to the guest list — FacilitiesBot please confirm.
FacilitiesBot: Guest access request received for Liam. Approved. Elevator A will be held at 5:55pm.
Chris: FYI I'll bring spare napkins. Also low-key suggestion: loser of today's pick'em buys drinks next week. 
Devon: ":thumbsup:" for stakes. remote-friendly version: whoever scores the least fantasy points today sends a GIF apology. 
Liam: deal. also putting the meetup pin here: https://maps.example.com/?q=rooftop+garden (follow stairs by the west lobby)
Ana: quick directions block: ```
Stairs from West Lobby -> Rooftop Garden entrance -> turn right near planters -> small turf area
Do not bring cleats (turf only).
```
Tara: perfect. see y'all at 6 — and if it rains we move to the 3rd-floor lounge. 
OpsBot: Poll closed. Results: tacos 5, bagels 1, empanadas 2. "Tacos" selected as halftime snack.
Chris: tacos confirmed. ordering from Taqueria Luna at 5:40pm. ETA 5:55pm.
Devon: love it. I'll pre-pay and Venmo whoever. 
Ana: thanks team. posting final reminder tomorrow AM. GIF: https://giphy.com/soccer-sunset.gif
